articles.headline: Judge's first homer since May 24 helps clinch postseason berth for Yankees in 8-3 win at Twins
articles.description: — Aaron Judge hit a three-run home run that capped a six-run eighth inning, and the New York Yankees beat the Minnesota Twins 8-3 Monday on a night they clinched their 61st postseason berth and ninth in 10 seasons.
